<script>
(() => {
  const chips = document.querySelectorAll('.chips button');
  const items = document.querySelectorAll('.timeline li');
  const hint = document.getElementById('skill-hint');
  const defaultHint = hint.textContent;
  chips.forEach(c => c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false'));

  function apply(skill) {
    let n = 0;
    items.forEach(li => {
      const match = !skill || li.dataset.skills.split('|').includes(skill);
      li.classList.toggle('dim', !match);
      li.classList.toggle('hit', !!skill && match);
      if (skill && match) n++;
    });
    hint.textContent = skill
      ? `${skill}: used in ${n} ${n === 1 ? 'place' : 'places'} below. Click again to clear.`
      : defaultHint;
  }

  chips.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const on = btn.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== 'true';
    chips.forEach(c => c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false'));
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
    apply(on ? btn.dataset.skill : null);
  }));
})();
</script>
